title: Allergy Action Plan Incident Report Form
subtitle: An original operational incident report for allergy action plan that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Allergy Action Plan Incident Report Form supports the complete allergy action plan workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Allergy Action Plan Incident Report Form when the assigned allergy-plan coordinator needs one fillable record for approved allergy plan, allergen controls, emergency supplies, response, and handoff without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Allergy action plan incident report identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this incident report to one approved allergy plan, allergen controls, emergency supplies, response, and handoff record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

sections.title: Allergy action plan incident facts and immediate condition
sections.guidance: Record direct observations, reported information, exact times, and unknowns without blame or diagnosis.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan incident indicators
items: Known, suspected, or uncertain allergen exposure
Symptom or reaction requiring plan activation
Emergency medication administered, delayed, unavailable, or disputed
Food label, ingredient, meal, or cross-contact control failure
Wrong student, plan, medication, or supply selected
Emergency services, guardian, or qualified reviewer contacted
Private allergy or health information exposed
Supply count, response record, or follow-up did not reconcile

blocks.label: Event time, location, and information source
Chronological facts, exact words when necessary, source of each fact, unknowns, and observed impact

fields.label: Chronological facts, exact words, source, unknowns, and observed impact

blocks.label: Response and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records an allergy action-plan workflow; it does not diagnose an allergy, interpret symptoms, invent exposure limits, or replace qualified directions or emergency services. Use only the current approved plan and authorization. Stop routine activity for any mismatch, suspected exposure, symptom, or unavailable control, protect privacy, and route response decisions to qualified authorized staff.

sections.title: Allergy action plan people, property, records, and evidence
sections.guidance: Collect only information needed for response and follow-up; use approved restricted storage.

blocks.label: Involved or affected people
Property, system, document, or evidence references
Conflicting reports, missing records, unavailable evidence, privacy limits, and unresolved facts

fields.label: Conflicting reports, missing evidence, privacy limits, and unresolved facts

sections.title: Allergy action plan response, notification, and operating decision
sections.guidance: Document the action actually taken, why it was selected, who authorized it, and what remains unresolved.

blocks.label: Immediate actions and safeguards
items: Stopped or limited the affected allergy action plan activity, movement, or release
Protected the child, participant, volunteer, or affected person from further exposure
Used emergency services or the qualified response route when indicated
Reconciled identity, roster, headcount, item, or custody status
Notified the assigned allergy-plan coordinator and authorized guardian-facing route
Preserved objective facts and minimum-necessary evidence
Protected private records and restricted sensitive information
Established a temporary allergy action plan control and accountable follow-up owner

blocks.label: Notification and escalation log
Allergy action plan incident operating decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the guardian, qualified health professional, and authorized allergy-response staff.

sections.title: Allergy action plan review, exception ownership, and corrective follow-up
sections.guidance: Preserve questions as questions and assign evidence, correction, and recipient follow-up.

blocks.label: Open question, action, owner, due point, and review
Reviewer observations, corrections to the initial record, limitations, and rationale for final disposition

fields.label: Reviewer observations, corrections, limitations, and disposition rationale

blocks.label: Incident exception and escalation indicators
items: Routine activity cannot proceed under the current allergy plan
Guardian authorization or qualified plan direction is incomplete
Student, allergen, plan, medication, or supply does not reconcile
Meal, activity, cross-contact, staffing, or setting control is unavailable
Possible exposure, symptom, reaction, or emergency response is active
Response, supply custody, notification, or follow-up remains unresolved

sections.title: Allergy action plan outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan closeout controls
items: Allergy-plan readiness and response status accepted
Guardian and qualified-review communication recorded
Unresolved exposure, control, or supply action has an owner
Emergency medication and equipment returned to approved custody
Meal, facility, health, or program follow-up linked
Allergy record stored with privacy and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome and next action
Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Incident Report closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
